claim.text: Formula Atlas documents Microsoft-specified SEQUENCE defaults and array output separately from its local 100000-cell cap, dimension coercion, non-finite error order, and unsupported worksheet spill projection. This distinction does not claim full Excel compatibility.
claim.subject_definition: Run 19 SEQUENCE and array-result scope statements in Formula Atlas

source.excerpt: Microsoft documents =SEQUENCE(rows,[columns],[start],[step]), says omitted optional arguments default to 1, describes the array dimensions, and says that a final array result spills into the worksheet grid. Microsoft documents worksheet grid limits separately.
source.subject_definition: Microsoft Support SEQUENCE function and Excel specifications and limits
source.scope: Public Microsoft pages retrieved 2026-09-24: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/excel/functions/sequence-function and https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/excel/excel-specifications-and-limits. This assessment covers documented defaults/array output and the separation from Formula Atlas local resource/evaluation profiles; it does not assess the implementation code.
